criteria.description: Interpret result matches expect.outcome (intent, config_error, or provider_error).
criteria.fpRisk: Treating a thrown config/provider error as a successful intent.
criteria.fnRisk: Failing a valid intent because of non-gating metadata noise.

criteria.fpRisk: Accepting create_* when clarification was required.
criteria.fnRisk: Rejecting a correct create_* because style wording differed.

criteria.description: Provider id matches expect.provider when asserted (e.g. rule_parser).
criteria.fpRisk: Crediting rule_parser when the LLM path actually ran.
criteria.fnRisk: Failing when only model string differs but provider is correct.

criteria.description: Clarification missingFields contains every entry in expect.missingFieldsContains.
criteria.fpRisk: Passing vague clarifications that omit the required field id.
criteria.fnRisk: Failing when extra missingFields are present beyond the required set.

criteria.fpRisk: Accepting invented location_arrival_offset when arrival-only was required.
criteria.fnRisk: Failing equivalent trigger aliases that the product does not use.

criteria.description: Location trigger placeSlug matches expect.placeSlug / canonical place.
criteria.fpRisk: Accepting hallucinated or misspelled place slugs.
criteria.fnRisk: Failing when alias resolution maps an allowed synonym (not in v1).

criteria.description: location_arrival_offset.offsetMinutes matches expect.offsetMinutes; noInventedOffset forbids fabricated minutes.
criteria.fpRisk: Passing an invented default offset as if the user stated it.
criteria.fnRisk: Failing explicit word/digit offsets the parser already supports.

criteria.description: Reminder taskId matches expect.taskId / canonical grounded task when asserted.
criteria.fpRisk: Accepting invented task ids not present in context.
criteria.fnRisk: Failing optional null taskId when unbound reminders are allowed.

criteria.fpRisk: Accepting empty or unrelated activity strings.
criteria.fnRisk: Failing on minor punctuation the executor would strip.

criteria.description: Invalid stub/schema/config paths do not emit a successful create_* intent.
criteria.fpRisk: Silently coercing invalid LLM JSON into a create intent.
criteria.fnRisk: Over-rejecting valid stub intents that pass Zod.

criteria.description: Diagnosis expectedFailureClassification matches scorer classification of the stub/actual intent.
criteria.fpRisk: Labeling ignored_grounding as missing context (wrong remediation).
criteria.fnRisk: Missing a true grounding failure when ids diverge.

criteria.description: Diagnosis expectedRemediation matches the remediation the scorer derives (reanchor vs grounding_clarification vs schema_reject).
criteria.fpRisk: Suggesting add-more-context when re-anchor to canonical id is required.
criteria.fnRisk: Demanding re-anchor when context was truly absent.

criteria.description: Optional deterministic execute probe matches expect.execute.ok/reason without live DB.
criteria.fpRisk: Treating missing place/task as a successful write.
criteria.fnRisk: Failing probes that only check intent shape when execute is null.

criteria.description: Clarification question is readable and actionable; reported but not CI-gating.
criteria.fpRisk: Over-weighting polish and masking correctness failures.
criteria.fnRisk: Noise in reports from wording variance across rule_parser strings.
